note: Attacker-controlled p_filesz value taken from the module PT_LOAD program header read from the core image; never validated against the actual size of the underlying file.
file_trimmed_end is assigned the raw phdr-derived offset + filesz (4GB) with no cap against the real file size, so it can be arbitrarily large for a tiny input file.
whole inherits the unbounded file_trimmed_end and is passed to read_eagerly to decide whether the whole module image must be materialized.
core_file_read_eagerly returns true for an mmap'd core because whole (4GB) exceeds buffer_available (file size), leaving elf == NULL so the image-filling block runs.
calloc allocates file_trimmed_end (4GB) bytes of zeroed memory for a 784-byte input, causing excessive memory usage / allocation failure.
